neighbours.label: the first piece 'sn' / 'Sn' of a split word: sn|ail, Sn|ipe, Sn|orkeling; whole-word ' snake' stays quiet
fire: A tiny snail crawled up the wall.
The Common Snipe nests in wet fields.
Snorkeling and diving are popular there.
The gardener crushed a snail under his boot.
We watched a snipe take off.
A snipe ran through the reeds.
quiet: A tiny beetle crawled up the wall.
The Common Teal nests in wet fields.
Swimming and diving are popular there.
The gardener crushed a slug under his boot.
We watched a heron take off.
A rail ran through the reeds.

notes: A tokenizer check shows ' snake', ' snorkel' and ' sneezed' do not split this way, so they are left out. Commas after medical symptoms are also on the card and are not covered.
